definition: ShiftInvariant C says moving every date by one step preserves C. shiftWorld gives the same path re-dated by one step. SameUpToDating f g says g is f after one common re-dating. A dated contrast treats f and its re-dating as rivals because their values at given times differ; an undated contrast compares paths only up to SameUpToDating. Changes f says some state differs from the next by value.
note: The formal results take no side on whether a dated contrast is genuine. The source context for that dispute is LEIBNIZ-III-6-TEMPORAL-REASON and CLARKE-III-4-6-TEMPORAL-REPLY, which are not formalized by these definitions. Changes is value difference only, not A-series passage.
